info.name: Hotel Management - SOAP Payment Gateway (Project F)
info.description:
Folder 1: SOAP calls to the Spring Boot legacy-payment-gateway (each with the full XML response saved as an example).
Folder 2: REST calls to the hotel-app API (port 5000), which consumes the SOAP service on invoice payment and updates MongoDB (Facture + Reservation). Run `npm run seed` first, then run the folder with the Collection Runner.
Folder 3: run after stopping Spring Boot to check the outage handling.

request.description: WSDL generated by DefaultWsdl11Definition from payment-gateway.xsd.

response.name: Get WSDL - response
response.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?><wsdl:definitions xmlns:wsdl="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/" xmlns:sch="http://soap.hotel.com/payment" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/" xmlns:tns="http://soap.hotel.com/payment" targetNamespace="http://soap.hotel.com/payment">
  <wsdl:types>
    <xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" elementFormDefault="qualified" targetNamespace="http://soap.hotel.com/payment">

    <!-- ===================== Simple types ===================== -->

    <xs:simpleType name="ReservationId">
        <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Reservation identifier sent by the hotel application.</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:minLength value="1"/>
            <xs:maxLength value="64"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="Amount">
        <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Strictly positive amount with at most 2 decimals, matching DECIMAL(19,2).</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
        <xs:restriction base="xs:decimal">
            <xs:minExclusive value="0"/>
            <xs:totalDigits value="19"/>
            <xs:fractionDigits value="2"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="CurrencyCode">
        <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD, EUR, BIF (VARCHAR(3)).</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:pattern value="[A-Z]{3}"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="CardToken">
        <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Simulated card token. The value DECLINED forces a declined payment.</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:minLength value="1"/>
            <xs:maxLength value="128"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="TransactionRef">
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:pattern value="TXN-[A-Z0-9]{8}"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="AuthorizationCode">
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:pattern value="AUTH-[A-Z0-9]{8}"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="PaymentStatus">
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="SUCCESS"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="DECLINED"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <xs:simpleType name="PaymentErrorCode">
        <xs:annotation><xs:documentation>Business error codes returned inside the SOAP fault detail.</xs:documentation></xs:annotation>
        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
            <xs:enumeration value="UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY"/>
            <xs:enumeration value="AMOUNT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED"/>
        </xs:restriction>
    </xs:simpleType>

    <!-- ===================== Operation messages ===================== -->

    <xs:element name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="reservationId" type="tns:ReservationId"/>
                <xs:element name="amount" type="tns:Amount"/>
                <xs:element name="currency" type="tns:CurrencyCode"/>
                <xs:element name="cardToken" type="tns:CardToken"/>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>

    <xs:element name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="transactionId" type="tns:TransactionRef"/>
                <xs:element name="status" type="tns:PaymentStatus"/>
                <!-- Only present when status = SUCCESS (auth_code is NULL otherwise). -->
                <xs:element minOccurs="0" name="authorizationCode" type="tns:AuthorizationCode"/>
                <xs:element name="amount" type="tns:Amount"/>
                <xs:element name="currency" type="tns:CurrencyCode"/>
                <xs:element name="issueDate" type="xs:dateTime"/>
                <xs:element name="receiptXmlData" type="xs:string"/>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>

    <!-- Placed in <detail> of the <soap:Fault> when a business rule rejects the payment. -->
    <xs:element name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="code" type="tns:PaymentErrorCode"/>
                <xs:element name="message" type="xs:string"/>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>
</xs:schema>
  </wsdl:types>
  <wsdl:message name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault">
    <wsdl:part element="tns:processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault" name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault">
    </wsdl:part>
  </wsdl:message>
  <wsdl:message name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest">
    <wsdl:part element="tns:processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest" name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest">
    </wsdl:part>
  </wsdl:message>
  <wsdl:message name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse">
    <wsdl:part element="tns:processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse" name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse">
    </wsdl:part>
  </wsdl:message>
  <wsdl:portType name="PaymentGatewayPort">
    <wsdl:operation name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceipt">
      <wsdl:input message="tns:processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest" name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest">
    </wsdl:input>
      <wsdl:output message="tns:processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse" name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse">
    </wsdl:output>
      <wsdl:fault message="tns:processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault" name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault">
    </wsdl:fault>
    </wsdl:operation>
  </wsdl:portType>
  <wsdl:binding name="PaymentGatewayPortSoap11" type="tns:PaymentGatewayPort">
    <soap:binding style="document" transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/>
    <wsdl:operation name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceipt">
      <soap:operation soapAction=""/>
      <wsdl:input name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptRequest">
        <soap:body use="literal"/>
      </wsdl:input>
      <wsdl:output name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptResponse">
        <soap:body use="literal"/>
      </wsdl:output>
      <wsdl:fault name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault">
        <soap:fault name="processPaymentAndGenerateReceiptFault" use="literal"/>
      </wsdl:fault>
    </wsdl:operation>
  </wsdl:binding>
  <wsdl:service name="PaymentGatewayService">
    <wsdl:port binding="tns:PaymentGatewayPortSoap11" name="PaymentGatewayPortSoap11">
      <soap:address location="http://localhost:8080/ws"/>
    </wsdl:port>
  </wsdl:service>
</wsdl:definitions>
